name: Bellarmine University
academic_ranking: Private Catholic university (Doctoral/Professional Universities). U.S. News & World Report National University ranking #280; Washington Monthly #331. Accredited by SACSCOC; business school AACSB-accredited. ~3,077 students (2,365 undergraduate) as of fall 2025, offering 50+ majors and seven doctoral programs.
financial_aid: Published undergraduate tuition and fees of $48,770 for 2024-2025 (source: NCES College Navigator, unitid 156286). As a private institution, Bellarmine offers merit- and need-based institutional aid; specific package figures not confirmed from a live source during this research.
facilities_notes: Softball competes at the NCAA Division I level in the ASUN Conference; specific softball facility details not confirmed from a live source during this research.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I women's softball program competing in the ASUN Conference. Bellarmine athletics transitioned to Division I in 2020.
notes: Coaching staff and roster captured live from the official athletics site on 2026-07-30. Softball coaches page (https://athletics.bellarmine.edu/sports/softball/coaches) lists 4 staff. Roster page listed 22 players. Tuition ($48,770, 2024-2025) sourced from NCES College Navigator (unitid 156286) as the school's own tuition page was not reachable. No Twitter/X handles were listed on the staff directory.
